Paper boats along the gutter
racing past the corner shop
every puddle is an ocean
and the rain will never stop

Sing it loud and sing it slow
let the little rivers go
sing it loud and sing it slow
all the way to where they flow

Window light across the kitchen
kettle humming on the stove
someone whistles half a melody
of a tune nobody wrote

Sing it loud and sing it slow
let the little rivers go
sing it loud and sing it slow
all the way to where they flow
